stem:
A summer camp offered campers a choice of sports to play in the afternoon. The campers' choices are shown in the table.

Sports Choices

| Sport     | Number of Campers |
|-----------|-------------------|
| Basketball| 10                |
| Soccer    | 15                |
| Tennis    | 5                 |
| Volleyball| 10                |

Use the data in the table to complete the statements.

Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the sentences.

The sport or pair of sports that represents the mode of the data is [blank_1].

The percentage of campers who chose basketball was [blank_2].
